text:
- **Pull request checks:** Pull requests now start fewer macOS jobs. Docs-only pull requests skip the Go test matrix. Each pull request runs only the Go tests that its change can affect. On pull requests, macOS runs only the tests whose behaviour can differ by OS. Code pull requests finish faster, but not as fast as the target.
- **Agent questions and asks:** Agents now open owner-requested projects, sprints and tasks without asking leave. The owner-request judge blocks such leave requests as needless asks. The store now records question needs. Work started so ask-tool questions can be answered on the site too.
- **AGENTS.md map:** AGENTS.md is now a short map that Claude Code, Codex and Grok Build read in full. An agent grades it against a rubric on every pull request. The check signs in through workload identity federation, with no stored API key.
- **Sprint close and code:** Sprint close now checks only the covers patterns the sprint added or changed while open. Another session's pending pattern no longer blocks a close. The command code is split by noun. Old Python-port code is removed.
